subtitle: Ask your question; the answer is computed from your figures, not guessed.

chat.placeholder: Ask a question about this data…
chat.disclaimer: Demo — answers are generated from your demo data.
chat.generic: In the demo I answer the suggestions below. In production I query the whole dataset — streams, revenue, contracts, rights — and cite my sources.

greeting.artist: Hi {name} — I have your last 24 months in front of me. Ask me anything about your streams, revenue or rights.
greeting.label: Hi — I have the consolidated data of the {count} artists on {label} in front of me. Ask me anything about running the roster.

suggestions.topSource: Which source earns me the most?
suggestions.topArtist: Which artist is the most profitable?

answers.bestMonth: Over 24 months, your best month is {month}: {amount} in revenue across all sources, {pct} above your monthly average ({avg}). The peak comes mostly from streaming and live.
answers.growth: Over the last 30 days, your streams are moving {delta} versus the previous 30 days, with {streams} total streams. Your monthly listener base stands at {listeners}, and your underlying pace is {growthRate} per month.
answers.topSource: Over 12 months, your top revenue source is {source}: {amount}, or {pct} of your total ({total}).
answers.audit: My reconciliation finds {count, plural, =0 {no gap} one {# gap} other {# gaps}} between expected and reported, totalling {amount}. That's a question to ask, not money in hand: the Audit page holds the verification letters.
answers.bestMonthLabel: Over 24 months, the roster's best month is {month}: {amount} in consolidated revenue, {pct} above the monthly average ({avg}).
answers.growthLabel: Over 30 days, the roster totals {streams} streams, moving {delta} versus the previous period. The momentum is driven by your developing artists.
answers.topArtist: {artist} is your most profitable artist: {net} in net result over 12 months, at a {margin} margin. Revenue generated: {revenue}.
answers.auditLabel: Across the roster I find {count, plural, =0 {no gap} one {# gap} other {# gaps}} between expected and reported, totalling {amount} across {artists, plural, one {# artist} other {# artists}}. These are questions to ask, not money in hand — the letters are on the Audit page.
